bipm-si-brochure-9.title: The International System of Units (SI), 9th edition
bipm-si-brochure-9.publisher: Bureau International des Poids et Mesures (BIPM)
bipm-si-brochure-9.notes: Defines SI base units, the 24 SI prefixes (including ronna, quetta, ronto, and quecto added in 2022), and non-SI units accepted for use with the SI (litre, tonne, hour, minute, day, electronvolt).

nist-sp811.title: Guide for the Use of the International System of Units (SI), NIST Special Publication 811
nist-sp811.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
nist-sp811.notes: Appendix B provides conversion factors from non-SI units to SI units, including thermochemical calorie (4.184 J), slug (14.5939 kg), and thermodynamic temperature offsets.

nist-hb44.title: Specifications, Tolerances, and Other Technical Requirements for Weighing and Measuring Devices, NIST Handbook 44, Appendix C
nist-hb44.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
nist-hb44.notes: General tables of US customary units of measurement (acre, US liquid gallon).

nist-codata.title: CODATA Recommended Values of the Fundamental Physical Constants
nist-codata.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
nist-codata.notes: Provides the exact post-2019 SI redefinition value for the electronvolt (1 eV = 1.602176634e-19 J).

intl-yard-pound-1959.title: International Yard and Pound Agreement (1959)
intl-yard-pound-1959.notes: Agreement defining 1 international yard = 0.9144 m and 1 avoirdupois pound = 0.45359237 kg exactly, from which inch, foot, mile, and ounce derive.

convention-calendar.title: School physics calendar-time conventions
convention-calendar.notes: Standard classroom convention where 1 day = 86,400 s, 1 month = 30 days (2,592,000 s), and 1 year = 365 days (31,536,000 s). The Julian year (365.25 days = 31,557,600 s) is provided separately.

iec-80000-13.title: IEC 80000-13: Quantities and units — Part 13: Information science and technology
iec-80000-13.notes: Defines binary prefixes (kibi, mebi, gibi, tebi) alongside decimal SI prefixes for bytes and bits.
